# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Join Us at AABIP 2026

You are invited to the 9^{th} Annual Conference of American Association for Bronchology and
Interventional Pulmonology to be held on August 20-22, 2026, Denver, Colorado, USA.

This conference brings together leading experts from around the world in Bronchology and
Interventional Pulmonology, providing a global platform to explore groundbreaking advancements in
fields such as Advanced Diagnostic Bronchoscopy, Therapeutic Bronchoscopy, Pleural Diseases,
Healthcare Transformation, and Thoracic Surgery. More than just an educational experience, it is a
unique opportunity to connect, collaborate, and contribute to shaping the future of healthcare in a
dynamic and inclusive environment.

We look forward to welcoming you to the AABIP 2026!

### Who Are We?

Since its founding in 1992, the AABIP has been a unifying source for information regarding the
fields of Bronchology and Interventional Pulmonology. Over the last few years, we have achieved
significant milestones in IP Fellowships, IP Board Certification, Education & Training, and the
Journal of Bronchology and Interventional Pulmonology.

## Setting The Standard of High Quality

The Association of Interventional Pulmonology Program Directors was established to set the standard
for high quality, patient centered, evidence based training in the field of minimally invasive
diagnostic and therapeutic procedures of the thorax.

[Applicants][21] [Directors][22]
* ## The Process
  
  [Get Started][23]
* **.01** Complete the online application
* **.02** Upload your documents
* **.03** Select Membership Fellowship Programs

## Who We Are

Interventional Pulmonology (IP) is an emerging subspecialty of pulmonary medicine. Dedicated IP
training requires an additional year of training after traditional pulmonary and critical care
fellowship. Training focuses on the diagnosis and management of central airway obstruction, lung
cancer, pleural diseases, and specialized procedural training in various airway and pleural
procedures. As a result of growth in technology, the field of IP continues to expand to treat a wide
range of pulmonary diseases.

# Overview

A proud member of the IHH Healthcare Network, Gleneagles Hospitals, India – a Fortis Network
Hospital* stands as a beacon of medical excellence in India. Gleneagles India operates a network of
world-class multi-specialty hospitals in Chennai, Bangalore, and Hyderabad, equipped with over 900
state-of-the-art beds. Recognised as the pioneers in the fields of Kidney, Liver, Heart, and Lung
Transplants, we're at the forefront of providing comprehensive Multi-organ Transplant services
throughout the nation. Our commitment doesn't end there: Gleneagles Hospitals is steadfast in its
mission to consolidate and further its reputation as the preferred destination for Multi-organ
Transplants for patients spanning from India to the Middle East, Africa, and Southeast Asia.

 

Our vision is clear – to make premium healthcare both accessible and affordable for everyone. We
take immense pride in our dedicated team of consultants and surgeons, who are not just leaders in
their respective specialities but also revered figures in the medical world.

 

Join us on our journey towards a healthier future.

 

*Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai is currently not a part of Fortis Network Hospital

## Our Locations

See what our most popular locations have to offer

### [ Australia ][57]

#### Australia

Australia consistently ranks as one of the world’s best places to live by all indices of income,
human development, healthcare and civil rights.

Due to Australia's growing population and booming economy there’s a real need for doctors. There is
a mix of public and private healthcare in Australia and depending on your preference, you could find
yourself in a metropolitan teaching hospital or in a remote outpost covering a large geographical
area.

[Find out More ][58]

### [ Canada ][59]

#### Canada

Often featuring prominently in 'Most Liveable' location polls, Canada is a popular destination for
doctors looking to further their medical careers whilst also being able to enjoy a more
active outsdoor lifestyle.

Stunning vistas, expansive national parks, friendly citizens and a number of popular cosmopolitan
cities ensure Canada has something to offer everyone.

Find out more about the opportunities we have available today...

[Find out More ][60]

### [ Caribbean ][61]

#### Caribbean

Truly a tropical paradise, the islands of the Caribbean are alive with vibrant coral reefs, marine
life, flora, exotic birds and uniquely charming towns and villages. This natural beauty is
accompanied by high standards of living in addition to a sophisticated international culture and
flourishing financial industry.

### [ China ][63]

#### China

China is a country rich with culture and history, has a thriving economy, and is becoming
increasingly popular with expats looking to experience life from a different perspective.

The country is vast and customs and traditions vary greatly between locations. Embracing these
differences is all part of making the most of your time in this amazing destination.

Discover more about living and working as a doctor in China...

[Find out More ][64]

### [ New Zealand ][65]

#### New Zealand

New Zealand, also known as Aotearoa “Land of the Long White Cloud” is a relatively small country
with majestic landscapes and beautiful coastlines.

Made up of the North Island, the South Island and Stewart Island, there is a lot to explore and the
climate and landscape changes as you travel from north to south, from east to west, inland to
coastal, from summer to winter.

It’s possible to come to NZ on a fixed-term contract (12 months minimum) to see how you like it, or
permanently if you’re ready to make the commitment...

[Find out More ][66]

### [ Singapore ][67]

#### Singapore

Singapore is a cosmopolitan city with a tropical climate, diverse multi-cultural environment
and large ex-pat community.  Recently voted the best place in Asia to live, work and play the city
boasts safe streets, stunning sights, stylish shops and a vibrant social scene.

Asia’s leading multi-faceted medical hub is a particularly attractive destination for overseas
Doctors, with a global reputation for excellence, efficiency and effectiveness.

[Find out More ][68]

### [ China ][63]

#### China

China is a country rich with culture and history, has a thriving economy, and is becoming
increasingly popular with expats looking to experience life from a different perspective.

The country is vast and customs and traditions vary greatly between locations. Embracing these
differences is all part of making the most of your time in this amazing destination.

Discover more about living and working as a doctor in China...

### [ New Zealand ][65]

#### New Zealand

New Zealand, also known as Aotearoa “Land of the Long White Cloud” is a relatively small country
with majestic landscapes and beautiful coastlines.

Made up of the North Island, the South Island and Stewart Island, there is a lot to explore and the
climate and landscape changes as you travel from north to south, from east to west, inland to
coastal, from summer to winter.

It’s possible to come to NZ on a fixed-term contract (12 months minimum) to see how you like it, or
permanently if you’re ready to make the commitment...

#### Singapore

Singapore is a cosmopolitan city with a tropical climate, diverse multi-cultural environment
and large ex-pat community.  Recently voted the best place in Asia to live, work and play the city
boasts safe streets, stunning sights, stylish shops and a vibrant social scene.

Asia’s leading multi-faceted medical hub is a particularly attractive destination for overseas

## Why Choose Hoag

#### At Hoag, we combine clinical excellence with compassionate, personalized care—earning top
#### rankings for quality, safety and outcomes.

Patients choose Hoag because we deliver more than expertise. We offer access to advanced treatments,

### DR. RAKESH CHAWLAPRESIDENT

Dear Esteemed Colleagues, Respected Teachers, Friends and Young Bronchologists,
Greetings!

It is with immense humility, gratitude and a deep sense of responsibility that I accept the
privilege of serving as the President of the Indian Association for Bronchology.

I sincerely thank every member of our association for the trust and confidence bestowed upon me.
This honour belongs not only to me but to every teacher, colleague and student who has walked with
me throughout my journey in Interventional Pulmonology.

The Indian Association for Bronchology has emerged as one of India’s most dynamic scientific
organizations, committed to excellence in education, research, innovation and patient care. Today,
Interventional Pulmonology is no longer a niche specialty—it is at the forefront of modern
respiratory medicine, transforming the diagnosis and treatment of complex thoracic diseases through
minimally invasive procedures.

Having devoted my professional life to advancing bronchoscopy and interventional pulmonology,
introducing and refining new techniques, and contributing to the development of national guidelines,
I strongly believe that our greatest achievements still lie ahead. The future belongs to those who
innovate, collaborate and continuously challenge existing boundaries.

As President, my vision is built upon five important pillars:

Education: Creating world-class educational opportunities through structured hands-on workshops,
simulation-based learning, fellowships and digital education platforms.

Innovation: Encouraging indigenous research, development of newer bronchoscopic techniques, and
adoption of emerging technologies including robotic bronchoscopy, advanced navigation systems,
artificial intelligence and precision medicine.

Guidelines & Standardisation: Developing evidence-based national guidelines and consensus statements
that will help standardize interventional pulmonary practice across the country while maintaining
the highest standards of patient safety.

Research: Promoting multicentric clinical research, registries and collaborative scientific projects
that will enable India to contribute significantly to global respiratory science.

Young Leadership: Mentoring the next generation of interventional pulmonologists by providing equal
opportunities, leadership training and academic encouragement. Our young members are the future
strength of IAB, and investing in them is investing in the future of our specialty.

India possesses extraordinary clinical experience, exceptional talent and enormous patient
diversity. Together, these strengths can position our country as a global leader in Interventional
Pulmonology. Let us not merely adopt innovations from around the world—let us create innovations
that the world adopts from India.

I envision the Indian Association for Bronchology becoming an internationally respected academic
organization, collaborating with leading respiratory societies across the globe while proudly
showcasing Indian expertise and scientific excellence.

None of these aspirations can be achieved by an individual alone. Success will depend upon the
collective wisdom, experience and enthusiasm of every member of our association. I invite each one
of you to actively participate, contribute ideas, undertake research, mentor young colleagues and
help shape the future of our specialty.

I express my sincere appreciation to all the past Presidents, Governing Council members and senior
mentors whose dedication has laid the strong foundation upon which we continue to build. Their
vision has transformed IAB into the respected organization it is today.

To our younger colleagues, I offer this message: remain curious, remain compassionate, never stop
learning, and always remember that every technological advancement ultimately exists to improve the
lives of our patients.

As we embark upon this new journey together, let us reaffirm our commitment to excellence, ethical
practice, innovation and compassionate patient care.

Together, let us make the Indian Association for Bronchology not only the leading scientific society
in India but one of the most respected bronchology organizations in the world.

# Welcome to JCS Lung and Sleep Centre!

The JCS Lung & Sleep Centre was established in 2020 by Prof (Dr) JC Suri as a premier centre for
treating respiratory and sleep disorders in the heart of India’s capital, Delhi. There is a high
burden of respiratory disorders in Delhi owing to increasing levels of pollution.

#### Respiratory Care

Specialized respiratory care for breathing and sleep disorders.

#### Sleep Cure

Specialized care for diagnosing and treating sleep-related disorders.

#### Pulmonary Critical Care

Pulmonary Critical Care treats severe respiratory and critical illnesses.

#### Patient Education

Informing patients about their health conditions and treatment options.

### About The Best Pulmonologist in Delhi and a pioneer of critical care and sleep medicine in India

Pulmonologist by training, Prof JC Suri is a pioneer of **critical care** and **sleep medicine in

India’s first holistic Pulmonary, Critical Care and Sleep Medicine Department, which he headed from
1990 to 2018.

Medical Associates of Northwest Arkansas (MANA), is a group of local independent physicians working
together to provide exceptional, coordinated care for the people of Northwest Arkansas.
With locations across Northwest Arkansas, the MANA clinic group includes primary care physicians,
medical specialists, and diagnostic services to cover all your healthcare needs. 

[Meet Our Physicians][77]
“Our mission is to improve quality of life by providing compassionate, comprehensive, quality health
care.”

## Book an Appointment

Schedule a wellness visit to establish care with a family medicine, internal medicine, or pediatric
doctor to get started. Requesting an appointment is easy for new and established patients, with
several options. 

[Make an Appointment][78]

## Our Specialties

#### Asthma & Pulmonary Medicine

Pulmonology is the diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the respiratory tract and lungs.

#### Breast Cancer Screening

Mammograms, ultrasound, and breast MRI are used to detect breast cancer early

#### Breast Cancer Risk Assessment & Genetic Testing

Nurse consultation and testing to personalize screening for higher-risk patients

#### Chiropractic

Treatment focusing on spine alignment to relieve pain and improve function

#### Diabetes Care & Endocrinology

Endocrinology is the medical specialty focused on the endocrine system—the network of glands that
produce and regulate hormones.

#### Flu shots & Vaccines

Offered at locations across Northwest Arkansas

#### Foot and Ankle Care

Diagnosis and treatment of foot and ankle pain or injuries

#### Gynecology and Women’s Health

Comprehensive care focused on prevention, diagnosis, and treatment for women.

#### Internal Medicine

Primary care doctors specializing in the care of adults

#### Imaging

Advanced scans to diagnose internal conditions

#### Laboratory Services

Our Full-Service CLIA Accredited Laboratory offers an array of testing

#### Lung Cancer Screening

A Lung Cancer Screening exam can find lung cancer in its early stages

#### MRI

Uses magnets to create a detailed view inside of the body

#### Pediatrics

Primary care specializing in infants, children, and adolescent health.

#### Physical Therapy

Treatment to restore movement, strength, and function after injury or illness.

#### Psychiatry

Psychiatry is the diagnosis and treatment of mental health and emotional disorders.

#### Sleep Medicine

Diagnosis and treatment of sleep disorders to improve rest and health.

#### TMS

Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation is a treatment for depression, anxiety, and PTSD.

## **About APAPP**

The Association of Pulmonary Advanced Practice Providers (APAPP) is the first organization dedicated
to Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in pulmonary medicine. Members include doctors, nurses, nurse
practitioners, physician assistants, therapists, and other professionals passionate about advancing
pulmonology. Together, we work to improve patient care, promote professional growth, and support
those in the field. We offer valuable resources for advance practice providers, including access to
educational tools like the APAPP ACE App, pulmonology conferences, certification programs, research
opportunities, and a growing network of members committed to excellence in pulmonary, critical care,
and sleep medicine.

[Learn more about APAPP >][35]

## **Discover Our New Podcast**

The APAPP Podcast is designed for healthcare professionals specializing in pulmonary, critical care,
and sleep medicine, including advanced practice providers such as pulmonary doctors, nurse
practitioners, physician assistants, nurses, and therapists. This podcast offers valuable insights
and education tailored to Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in these fields. Stream episodes on
popular platforms like **[Apple Podcasts][36]** and **[Spotify][37]**, or watch video versions on
our **[YouTube][38]** and **[Spotify][39]**. Stay informed and connected with the latest updates in
pulmonology, critical care, and sleep medicine.

Пульмонология – ведущее направление работы НИИ пульмонологии, которое занимается выявлением,
лечением и профилактикой патологии нижних отделов дыхательных путей: трахеи, бронхов и легких.
* Обструктивные болезни легких (бронхиальная астма, ХОБЛ, хронический бронхит)
* Интерстициальные и гранулематозные болезни (саркоидоз, ИЗЛ)
* Заболевания с бронхоэктазами (бронхоэктатическая болезнь, муковисцидоз)
* Иные хронические неспецифические заболевания легких

### Торакальная хирургия

Выполняем весь спектр диагностических и высокотехнологичных хирургических вмешательств при
заболеваниях органов грудной клетки, строго следуя российским и международным клиническим
рекомендациям.
* Хирургия онкологических заболеваний: Лечение опухолей легкого, плевры, пищевода, средостения,
  тимуса и грудной стенки.
* Ре конструктивная и торакальная хирургия: Операции при патологии трахеи, деформациях грудной
  клетки, а также при новообразованиях грудной стенки.
* Хирургия воспалительных и обструктивных заболеваний легких: Лечение неспецифических воспалительных
  заболеваний легких и плевры, пневмоторакса и эмфиземы легких.
* Высокотехнологичные вмешательства (ВМП): Проведение сложных операций при всех перечисленных
  патологиях с использованием передовых медицинских технологий.

## Основные направления лечения

Пульмонология Торакальная хирургия Сердечно-сосудистая хирургия Рентгенэндоваскулярная хирургия

### Пульмонология и различные бронхолегочные патологии

Пульмонология – ведущее направление работы НИИ пульмонологии, которое занимается выявлением,
лечением и профилактикой патологии нижних отделов дыхательных путей: трахеи, бронхов и легких.
* Обструктивные болезни легких (бронхиальная астма, ХОБЛ, хронический бронхит)
* Интерстициальные и гранулематозные болезни (саркоидоз, ИЗЛ)
* Заболевания с бронхоэктазами (бронхоэктатическая болезнь, муковисцидоз)
* Иные хронические неспецифические заболевания легких

### Торакальная хирургия

Выполняем весь спектр диагностических и высокотехнологичных хирургических вмешательств при
заболеваниях органов грудной клетки, строго следуя российским и международным клиническим
рекомендациям.
* Хирургия онкологических заболеваний: Лечение опухолей легкого, плевры, пищевода, средостения,
  тимуса и грудной стенки.
* Ре конструктивная и торакальная хирургия: Операции при патологии трахеи, деформациях грудной
  клетки, а также при новообразованиях грудной стенки.
* Хирургия воспалительных и обструктивных заболеваний легких: Лечение неспецифических воспалительных
  заболеваний легких и плевры, пневмоторакса и эмфиземы легких.
* Высокотехнологичные вмешательства (ВМП): Проведение сложных операций при всех перечисленных
  патологиях с использованием передовых медицинских технологий.

### Сердечно-сосудистая хирургия

Кардиохирургическое отделение НИИ Пульмонологии ФМБА России — современное подразделение, оказывающее
высокотехнологичную помощь при ИБС, пороках сердца, заболеваниях аорты, эндокардите и опухолях
сердца.

Отделение оснащено оборудованием экспертного класса. Проводится тщательная предоперационная
диагностика: коронарография, ЭКГ, ЭхоКГ, КТ и МРТ, УЗИ, нагрузочные пробы. Для каждого пациента
разрабатывается индивидуальная программа реабилитации.
* Аортокоронарное шунтирование (на работающем сердце, в условиях ИК, MIDCAB, аутоартериальное);
* Реконструкция левого желудочка при аневризме;
* Протезирование и пластика клапанов;
* Реконструкция аорты;
* Удаление опухолей (миксом).

### Внутрисосудистая хирургия

Отделение рентгенохирургии НИИ Пульмонологии объединяет возможности эндоваскулярной и малоинвазивной
хирургии.

Ключевая особенность — гибридная операционная нового поколения, где одновременно работают хирурги
разных профилей. Это позволяет проводить операции одномоментно, снижая их травматичность, сокращая
реабилитацию и количество осложнений.

Мультидисциплинарная команда врачей обеспечивает индивидуальный подбор максимально безопасного
метода лечения.
* Коронарография и стентирование коронарных артерий.
* Ангиопластика и стентирование аорты и ее ветвей.
* Транскатетерная имплантация аортального клапана.
* Эмболизация и химиоэмболизация бронхиальных артерий.
* Диагностика (аортография, флебография, пульмонография) и лечение патологий вен.

### Медицинская реабилитация

Отделение медицинской реабилитации НИИ пульмонологии реализует комплексный, индивидуализированный
подход к восстановлению пациентов с патологиями дыхательной, сердечно-сосудистой систем и
онкологическими заболеваниями, используя собственную многопрофильную инфраструктуру для непрерывной
реабилитации на всех этапах стационарного лечения.
* Формирование единой системы реабилитации для пациентов с патологиями дыхательной,
  сердечно-сосудистой систем и онкологией
* Проведение реабилитационных мероприятий в острый период течения заболевания в условиях стационара
* Наличие специализированных кабинетов (физиотерапия, ЛФК, массаж), соляной пещеры и тренажерного
  зала
* Индивидуальный подбор программы восстановления для каждого пациента на каждом этапе лечения

### Диагностика

Клинико-диагностический центр объединяет многопрофильную команду экспертов и передовое цифровое
оборудование для проведения комплексной диагностики и лечения заболеваний «под ключ» в день
обращения пациента.

## Improving the Human Condition

Sanford Health, the largest rural health system in the United States, is dedicated to transforming
the health care experience and providing access to world-class health care in America's heartland.
Headquartered in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, the organization serves over 2 million patients and over
415,000 health plan members across 320,000 square miles. The integrated health system has 58 medical
centers, 289 clinic locations, 145 Good Samaritan senior living centers, 4,500 Sanford physicians
and advanced practice providers, 1,100 active clinical trials and studies, and five world clinic
locations around the globe.

Our Centers of Excellence offer compassionate care, experienced providers and advanced technology.
Learn more about these Sanford Health specialties.

[ Cancer View Sanford Cancer ][39]
[ Children's Health View Sanford Children's ][40]
[ Heart View Sanford Heart ][41]

## We Provide Medical Equipment Based On Categories Needs

[ Urology
][50]

We provide a range of innovative medical devices to support diagnosis, treatment, and therapy
related to urinary and reproductive health. Our products are designed to ensure ease of use for
healthcare professionals and optimal comfort for patients.

[ Gastroenterology
][51]

Our gastroenterology solutions include advanced diagnostic and therapeutic equipment designed to
address disorders of the digestive system. We are committed to supporting medical practices with
technology that enhances accuracy and efficiency.

[ Pulmonology
][52]

Focusing on respiratory system health, we offer medical devices designed for lung diagnostics and
treatment. Our products help healthcare professionals deliver optimal care to patients with
respiratory disorders.

[ Thorax, Cardiac & Vascular
][53]

We offer advanced medical devices designed to support diagnostics, interventions, and treatments in
the chest area, including thoracic, cardiac, and vascular systems. Our innovative solutions ensure
high precision and effectiveness, helping healthcare professionals deliver optimal outcomes and
improve patients' quality of life.

[ Neurosurgery
][54]

Our neurosurgery equipment is tailored to meet the needs of complex nerve surgeries, offering
high-precision technology to support the best outcomes in surgical procedures.

[ Laparoscopy
][55]

Our laparoscopy products offer minimally invasive solutions for a wide range of medical procedures,
providing benefits such as reduced risks of complications and faster recovery times for pataients.

[ Anesthesiology
][56]

We provide high-quality anesthesia equipment designed to support various medical procedures with
optimal safety and efficiency, ensuring comfort for both patients and healthcare professionals.

[ Dental
][57]

Our dental solutions include diagnostic and therapeutic devices that support modern dental
practices, helping dentists deliver the best care with cutting-edge technology.

[ Disinfectant
][58]

In the disinfectants category, we offer products that ensure cleanliness and sterility in medical
environments. Our disinfectants are designed to protect patients and healthcare professionals from
contamination risks.

## Who’s on your bench? The five people every high performer needs

Your clinical career is shaped not only by what you know, but by who helps you navigate what comes
next. Join us for the final episode in our mini-series exploring non-clinical skills that can help
you thrive in your clinical career. Today we explore how to develop the right team around you to
support your work, and what building that bench can mean for your career, and the life you build
alongside it.

[Listen Now Listen Now][97]

## Recognizing and managing secondary immunodeficiency in allergy clinics

In the first of our Respirology Reflections series, we spoke with Dr Shahzad Mustafa about
recognizing and managing secondary immunodeficiency in adults, particularly those treated for
allergy or asthma. He outlines the key medications and infection patterns that should raise concern,
how to distinguish secondary from primary immunodeficiency, and which initial tests can guide
referral. Dr Mustafa also discusses strategies such as vaccination, prophylaxis, and immunoglobulin
replacement, emphasizing the importance of early recognition and coordinated, multidisciplinary care
to reduce infectious complications and optimize patient outcomes.

[View Insight View Insight][98]

## How the American Lung Association programs advance asthma education and self-management

Effective asthma management requires more than medication alone. Education, self-management support,
and early intervention are essential to helping patients achieve better symptom control and improved
quality of life. To address these needs, the American Lung Association has developed a range of
evidence-based asthma programs for both adults and children, designed to build practical skills,
improve adherence, and support long-term disease management across home, school, and community
settings.

## Who’s on your bench? The five people every high performer needs

Your clinical career is shaped not only by what you know, but by who helps you navigate what comes
next. Join us for the final episode in our mini-series exploring non-clinical skills that can help
you thrive in your clinical career. Today we explore how to develop the right team around you to
support your work, and what building that bench can mean for your career, and the life you build
alongside it.

[Listen Now Listen Now][97]

## Recognizing and managing secondary immunodeficiency in allergy clinics

In the first of our Respirology Reflections series, we spoke with Dr Shahzad Mustafa about
recognizing and managing secondary immunodeficiency in adults, particularly those treated for
allergy or asthma. He outlines the key medications and infection patterns that should raise concern,
how to distinguish secondary from primary immunodeficiency, and which initial tests can guide
referral. Dr Mustafa also discusses strategies such as vaccination, prophylaxis, and immunoglobulin
replacement, emphasizing the importance of early recognition and coordinated, multidisciplinary care
to reduce infectious complications and optimize patient outcomes.

[View Insight View Insight][98]

## How the American Lung Association programs advance asthma education and self-management

Effective asthma management requires more than medication alone. Education, self-management support,
and early intervention are essential to helping patients achieve better symptom control and improved
quality of life. To address these needs, the American Lung Association has developed a range of
evidence-based asthma programs for both adults and children, designed to build practical skills,
improve adherence, and support long-term disease management across home, school, and community
settings.
